'''Ross''' was an independent [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Sontor Skipper]]''. Captain Ross was hired to transport harvested [[bestrum algae]] off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baralou]]'s [[Aqualis Base]] every twenty-three [[Local day/Legends|local days]]. During Ross' trips to Baralou, the captain traded [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] for gems with the indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]].
